name: What kind of damage can water cause to office equipment and electronics?

mainEntity.name: What kind of damage can water cause to office equipment and electronics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water can cause severe and irreversible damage to office equipment and electronics. For computers, servers, and copiers, water can short-circuit components, corrupt data, and lead to complete system failure. Even if equipment appears to dry out, residual moisture can cause corrosion and long-term operational issues. Important documents and paper-based records can be ruined by water absorption and subsequent mold growth. Professional assessment is crucial to determine if items are salvageable or if replacement is necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water can short-circuit electronics, corrupt data, and cause corrosion, leading to system failure. Documents can be ruined by absorption and mold.
